text:
Root cause: `FileSystemLoader`’s `uptodate` callback called `os.path.getmtime` unconditionally. After the file was deleted, this raised `FileNotFoundError` during cache validation instead of marking the cached template stale.

Changed the callback to catch `OSError` and return `False`, allowing Jinja to reload and raise `TemplateNotFound` or fall back to another loader as appropriate. All `tests/test_loader.py` tests pass.

final_text:
Root cause: `FileSystemLoader`’s `uptodate` callback called `os.path.getmtime` unconditionally. After the file was deleted, this raised `FileNotFoundError` during cache validation instead of marking the cached template stale.

Changed the callback to catch `OSError` and return `False`, allowing Jinja to reload and raise `TemplateNotFound` or fall back to another loader as appropriate. All `tests/test_loader.py` tests pass.
